effect.name: Normal Map
effect.desc: Builds a tangent-space normal map from the layer by running a 3x3 Sobel gradient over a height field taken from luminance, a single RGBA channel or saturation, with optional Gaussian pre-smoothing. Output modes show the encoded normals, the height map, or a Blinn-Phong lighting preview (light direction, color, ambient, specular) over the original.
